items.docs: API for searching audit logs. Limited to at most 30 day search, returns up to 100 records per page. Not recommended for bulk export.

items.docs: Download an organization's audit log records for a time range as a file, for archival, compliance, or offline analysis. For interactive browsing, use GET /audit-logs.
